header.title: Movie Cards Library
header.intro: Five computer-animated science fiction films, each rated out of 5.

movies.kingsglaive: King Regis, who oversees the land of Lucis, commands his army of soldiers to protect the kingdom from the Niflheim empire's plans to steal the sacred crystal.
movies.spiritsWithin: A scientist makes a last stand on Earth with the help of a ragtag team of soldiers against an invasion of alien phantoms.
movies.ghostInTheShell: A hacker known as the Puppet Master is hunted by a female cyborg cop and her partner. This film is a revised version of Ghost in the Shell (1995).
movies.appleseedAlpha: A young soldier, Deunan, and her cyborg partner Briareos survive in a New York ruined by World War III, searching for humanity's last hope: the legendary city of Olympus.
movies.residentEvil: Chris Redfield enlists Leon S. Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers to stop a vengeful death merchant from spreading a deadly virus in New York.
